title: Feedback-07: sustained exterior jump reproduction only
acceptance_criteria: The test-only production-input reproducer compiles without changing gameplay collision, gravity, ownership or prediction rules.

A registered lifecycle actor continuously presses inward during straight and diagonal exterior jump arcs against the production cabin; synchronized unobstructed baseline and exact native traces expose premature grounding, interrupted ascent or slow descent. Record actual selected/discovered counts and clean save/shutdown.
manual_steps: This is a reproduction fixture, not a delivered exterior-wall fix or M1 acceptance.
Build the shuttle fixture, walk into a solid exterior wall, jump and keep pressing inward through the apex; repeat slightly diagonally. Connected testing is owner-operated only.
